About Me

Hi! I’m Stephanie and when I’m not messing with data, my hobbies include making art, taking photographs, playing the ukulele, volunteering, and obsessing over my Rubik’s cube time. Below you’ll find some quick facts about me, some photos of my life, some of my artwork, and a bit more about my volunteer experience.

Volunteering

Giving back to my community has always been incredibly important to me. From donating to blood drives to conducting interviews for CBS, I try my best to be of help wherever I can. Two of my favorite organizations to work with are Food Bank for NYC (I volunteer in Harlem) and Columbia REAP, a ReEntry Acceleration Program that strives to improve employment opportunities for formerly incarcerated people and those with criminal records.
